fullData.title: A Day at the Beach
fullData.draft: We ate our picnic lunch on the warm sand. First, my family and I packed our big beach bag with sunscreen and towels. After lunch, we built a huge sandcastle and looked for seashells by the water. Finally, we watched the beautiful sunset before driving home.
